title: claimseed extractor output
description: What an extractor or bill auditor reports about one claimseed document, for scoring with `claimseed-core verify` or the MCP tool verify_document. It uses the answer key's vocabulary: field paths are the keys of documents[0].fields, and an error names its kind (docs/error-taxonomy.md) and its place as a fieldRef (a path in documents[0].fields, or a field inside it) or a lineRef (a path in the claims block). Either part may be left out to score only the other.

fields.description: Values read from the document, keyed by answer-key field path. Money may be a number or printed text such as "$1,234.50"; dates may be ISO, M/D/YYYY or "April 11, 2026"; text is compared without regard to case or repeated spaces.

errors.description: Billing errors the tool flagged. An error is found when its kind matches and its place names the same line or total as the answer key (for a duplicate charge, either line of the pair).
